description: The type of synchronization to perform on a grid session.

enum.name: PULL
enum.description: Update the grid with the latest data from the source, without writing the grid back to the source. Currently only supported for RecordSet-based grid sessions.

enum.name: PULL_PUSH
enum.description: Update the grid with the latest data from the source, then update the source (the referenced entities for EntityView-based grids, or the source RecordSet for RecordSet-based grids) with the grid data.
